DIMENSIONSMOD-VOID.description: Draw X cards. If you draw a card with the same Prefix, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold], this only happens one time per card. Different cards are [gold]Exhausted[/gold] upon draw. Colorless cards are ignored.
DIMENSIONSMOD-VOID.title: Void
DIMENSIONSMOD-EXHUME.description: Put a card from your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile into your hand. If it's a [red]Status[/red] or [red]Curse[/red] card, [gold]Purge[/gold] it. Colorless cards are ignored.
DIMENSIONSMOD-EXHUME.title: Exhume
DIMENSIONSMOD-PURGE.description: Removed until end of combat. Does [red]NOT[/red] go in your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile.
DIMENSIONSMOD-PURGE.title: Purge
DIMENSIONSMOD-CONSUME.title: Consume
DIMENSIONSMOD-ASTRAL.description: If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of this turn, it is [gold]Purged[/gold]. Cards Purged this way do not trigger any effects that activate upon being Purged.
DIMENSIONSMOD-ASTRAL.title: Astral
DIMENSIONSMOD-AUTOPLAY.description: This card automatically play itself when drawn.
DIMENSIONSMOD-AUTOPLAY.title: Autoplay
DIMENSIONSMOD-HIGGSBOSON.description: This card is considered Plasma, Cosmic and Dark
DIMENSIONSMOD-HIGGSBOSON.title: Higgs Boson
DIMENSIONSMOD-CHARGED.title: Charged
